package.description: A CLI wrapper for performing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authentication.

en-US.description: A CLI wrapper for performing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authentication.
en-US.longDescription: AzureAuth is a CLI wrapper for performing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authentication. It makes use of MSAL for authentication and caching, and is designed for authenticating and returning an access token for public client applications. It acts like a credential provider for Azure DevOps and any other public client application. Not to be confused with "Microsoft Authenticator".
en-US.name: AzureAuth

zh-CN.description: 用于执行 Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) 身份验证的 CLI 封装工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: AzureAuth 是一个用于执行 Microsoft Entra ID（Azure AD）身份验证的 CLI 封装工具。它利用 MSAL 进行身份验证和缓存，专为公共客户端应用程序进行身份验证并返回访问令牌而设计。它的作用类似于 Azure DevOps 以及任何其他公共客户端应用程序的凭据提供程序。请勿将其与“Microsoft Authenticator”混淆。
